verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork lets users describe an outcome, step away, and have Claude execute complex multi-step tasks agentically (browsing, computer use, scheduling recurring tasks), directly matching 'delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant.' This is corroborated by extensive first-party docs across multiple features (Cowork, Research, computer use). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of Cowork's delegation quality (community evidence covers Claude Code/chat quality but not Cowork delegation directly).
